effects.description: reels pile up behind your head, one every quarter second
numbered tiles fan out in an arc above your head
corner brackets snap onto your face and the camera follows you
your reels circle your head: in front at the bottom, behind you at the top
a fast punch-in on one word
a giant word drops in behind you
kill the lights, keep you lit
prints every instruction like a ticket, into the wall above your head
a moody colour grade: darker, softer, teal shadows
a before and after slider that sweeps across you
a checklist card beside your head that ticks off as you talk
a Follow button pops up and flips to Following
freeze the frame and point at something with a hand-drawn arrow
a glitchy uninstall bar that breaks the frame apart
your video shrinks into an Instagram reel card
keyboard keys rain down behind you
a big red stamp slams onto the screen
a 3, 2, 1 flip clock above your head
the frame tunnels into itself, spinning
you become a magazine cover, with the title behind your head
marker doodles draw themselves around you
black and white you, a giant red word behind, kinetic type stacked beside you
a clean headline card slides down and pushes you into the bottom of the frame
a soft lavender backdrop, a giant word behind you and a profile card that gets followed
grid-paper room, your reels pinned behind you and blue pills that get clicked
a punch-in with a clean two-line headline, the second line in a white box
your profile grid fills the wall behind you while a counter ticks up
a tier list drops in front of you and your item flies into S tier
split screen: b-roll on top with a price-tag sticker, you on the bottom
your reels fan out like a hand of phones in front of you, under a two-line headline
your shot builds itself out of glowing dots, then snaps into the full picture
a wall of your own reel headlines piles up behind your head, then your total views pop in front
a task list builds under your chin: each step spins, then ticks green
frosted glass phone widgets and mini artifacts float around your head, and an optional pill
a dark red cinematic grade with an editing timeline, a REC timecode and a glowing playhead
an Instagram comments sheet above your head types your word, posts it, gets a heart and your reply
a liquid glass card floats under your chin while a graph climbs and the number counts up
your reels spin around you in a 3D carousel, then slow to a stop
news pages cut on one word, locked in place behind your head
an iPhone settings card under your chin flips its switches on, one line at a time
the lights drop and a glowing LED sign types itself out behind you
a slow cinematic push-in from the wide shot to your face, the room melting out of focus
the camera pushes into one top corner, a liquid glass graph pops beside your head, then the other corner with a second graph
iMessage notifications pop in one after another, creamy glass with a soft glow, stacking up above the bottom of the frame
you shrink into the centre tile of your 3x3 profile grid on frosted glass, then 8 of your reels pop in around you, one per frame, view counts on every tile
a strip of yellow tape with your line lands on your chest
a blue selection box grabs your number and a cursor drags it bigger
the silent parts of your voice are trimmed away on screen until only your words are left
one huge serif word fills the wall behind you, then a red line crosses it out
a red crayon writes your word behind your head, then underlines it
your reel covers deal into a fan behind your head, one card at a time
